questions.prompt: Which overseas degree are you evaluating?
questions.why_it_matters: Degree level changes the investment horizon, funding pattern and appropriate employment benchmark.
questions.expert_context: This establishes the correct cost, funding and career-outcome comparison—not merely a ranking comparison.

questions.prompt: Which field should the degree prepare you for?
questions.why_it_matters: Employment outcomes and visa pathways differ materially by discipline.
questions.expert_context: I will compare options against the labour-market and academic realities of this field rather than treating every overseas degree alike.

questions.prompt: Which destination set are you seriously considering?
questions.why_it_matters: Tuition, living cost, work rights, salaries and immigration uncertainty are destination-specific.
questions.expert_context: Destination affects both sides of the ROI equation: what you spend and what opportunities remain after graduation.

questions.prompt: What is the maximum all-in amount your family can responsibly commit, including living costs?
questions.why_it_matters: Sticker tuition understates the investment; the responsible ceiling must include living and financing costs.
questions.expert_context: I will use this as a risk ceiling, not as permission to spend the entire amount.

questions.prompt: How would you fund the degree?
options: Family-funded with little or no debt
Mixed family funding and modest loan
questions.why_it_matters: The same programme can be sensible with a scholarship and dangerous with a large loan.
questions.expert_context: Funding structure determines downside resilience and therefore materially changes the recommendation.

questions.prompt: How competitive is your current academic and test profile for the target institutions?
questions.why_it_matters: A realistic portfolio needs ambitious, balanced and resilient admission options.
questions.expert_context: I will separate an attractive programme from a credible admission strategy.

questions.prompt: What is your intended path after graduation?
options: Work overseas then return to India
Return to India soon after graduation
questions.why_it_matters: ROI must use the salary market and career path you are actually likely to pursue.
questions.expert_context: This prevents an overseas salary headline from being used when your probable earning market is India.

questions.prompt: What must this investment optimise above everything else?
questions.why_it_matters: The best option depends on the objective—not prestige alone.
questions.expert_context: I will make the trade-off explicit rather than hiding it inside a generic score.

questions.prompt: How much admission, visa, debt and employment uncertainty can you responsibly accept?
questions.why_it_matters: Overseas education combines several risks that can compound.
questions.expert_context: The recommendation will penalise fragile outcomes more heavily when your ability to absorb disappointment is low.
